targets.name: Hive
targets.description: Original Hive Browser — WKWebView-based, kept buildable while HiveChromium is brought up

targets.name: HiveChromium
targets.description: New Chromium-backed Hive browser built around CefSwiftUI

targets.name: HiveWebKitSmoke
targets.description: Opt-in developer/runtime smoke target; requires live macOS window server and launches real WKWebView

targets.name: HiveCore
targets.description: Core library shared by Hive and HiveChromium

dependencies.name: mlx-swift-examples
dependencies.description: On-device ML inference; provides MLXLLM (model registry + trampoline) and MLXLMCommon (load/generate/UserInput/LoRAContainer)

dependencies.name: CefSwift
dependencies.description: Vendored CEF wrapper (MIT, pinned upstream 0.1.0 @ 2dca11e) with per-request-context scheme handler fix

scripts.name: build-hivechromium-app.sh
scripts.description: Assembles signed HiveChromium app bundle; stages Rust worker, builds SwiftPM product, bundles CEF framework/helpers via CefPlugin, embeds resources/icon, signs nested code and outer app

scripts.name: build-research-worker.sh
scripts.description: Builds and stages the Rust research worker (hive-fetch-worker) from native/hive-fetch-boundary; requires HIVE_WORKER_REQUIREMENT and Team ID

scripts.name: verify-research-worker.sh
scripts.description: Verifies signed Hive research worker: code signature, identifier, TeamIdentifier, designated requirement, and optionally stapled notarization ticket

scripts.name: verify-hivechromium-entitlements.sh
scripts.description: Validates HiveChromium.entitlements contains exactly the three required CEF keys (JIT, unsigned executable memory, disable-library-validation) and no others

scripts.name: verify-hivechromium-entitlement-application.sh
scripts.description: Verifies entitlements are correctly applied to the built app bundle

scripts.name: test-hivechromium-entitlements.sh
scripts.description: Tests the entitlements file for validity and required keys

scripts.name: preflight-hivechromium-app.sh
scripts.description: Structural release preflight checks on the assembled HiveChromium.app

scripts.name: smoke-test-hivechromium-app.sh
scripts.description: Smoke tests the built HiveChromium app

scripts.name: embed_webchrome.py
scripts.description: Python script for embedding Chrome resources

scripts.name: generate_icon.py
scripts.description: Generates app icon from SVG source

keys.purpose: CEF's bundled framework/helpers may not share the app Team ID

entitlements.validation: Strict allowlist enforced by verify-hivechromium-entitlements.sh; no other keys permitted

resources.description: Staged Rust research worker (hive-fetch-worker binary + hive-worker-requirement.txt)

cef_details.notes: Downloads and bundles CEF binaries via SwiftPM command plugin (CefPlugin); caches in .cef/

products_used: MLXLLM: model registry + trampoline registering with ModelFactoryRegistry; enables free loadModelContainer(directory:)
mlx_details.note: At 2.29.1 the examples renamed MLXLlama product to MLXLLM; public surface is LLMModelFactory/ModelContainer/Chat.Message; weights required for #if canImport(MLXLMCommon) path; otherwise falls back to Mock provider

rust_worker.name: hive-fetch-boundary

binaries.name: hive-fetch-worker
binaries.description: Cross-platform SSRF-aware HTTP/TLS research fetch boundary for Hive

rust_worker.verification: scripts/verify-research-worker.sh validates code signature, TeamIdentifier, designated requirement, and optionally stapled notarization ticket

ci.name: HiveChromium Release
key_steps: Fail closed when protected release inputs are incomplete (validates all secrets)
Require explicit hardened-runtime policy (validates entitlements and scripts)
Import Developer ID certificate into ephemeral keychain
Build and assemble signed HiveChromium.app (via build-hivechromium-app.sh)
Verify signed bundle before notarization (preflight, worker verification, codesign)
Submit to Apple notarization (notarytool with API key)
Publish: create draft GitHub release with DMG
